name: Verify Cognitive Access Barriers
summary: Verify consistent help, redundant entry, and accessible authentication against an observed process walkthrough.
description: Verify three WCAG 2.2 criteria by walking a process end to end, consistent help (3.2.6, A), redundant entry (3.3.7, A) and accessible authentication (3.3.8, AA), and record the reading, recovery and time demands no in-scope criterion measures. Use when completing a task requires the user to remember, transcribe, or hunt for something.
risk_reason: This skill verifies consistent help, redundant entry, and accessible authentication against an observed process walkthrough; it does not accept an essential, security, or no-longer-valid exception as satisfied because the owner asserted it.
refuses: It does not claim legal compliance, certification, or full conformance from a bounded walkthrough or an automated scan.
It does not accept an essential, security, or no-longer-valid exception as satisfied because the owner asserted it.
It does not report an adjacent demand, such as reading level or a time limit, as a result against the three criteria it verifies.
It does not treat a completed walkthrough by a tester without the relevant disability as evidence of lived cognitive load.

operational.latency_reason: The skill verifies consistent help, redundant entry, and accessible authentication against an observed process walkthrough, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
